Metadata.title: SurShongi — Your voice. Their strings. One song.
Metadata.description: A home for musicians in Bangladesh to find each other and collaborate remotely. Vocals, guitar, tabla, mixing, and everything in between.

Hero.sub: If you sing but don't play guitar, find someone who does, send a take, and build the song together. Guitar is only the start.
Hero.vocalistHint: Find the part you can't play

Stream.title: Sample tracks
Stream.note: Previews of the player. Real profiles come next.

How.title: Three steps
How.sub: Find someone, talk it through, and trade the files — in one place.

steps.title: Open a profile
steps.body: Your name, your city, and what you do. YouTube and audio samples can come later.

steps.title: Send a request
steps.body: What you need, the genre, and the timing. Add a reference track if you have one.

steps.title: Talk, then take the song
steps.body: Terms stay in the thread. The finished track comes back there.

Paths.title: Start from either side
Paths.sub: One account can hold more than one role. For now, see which door is yours.
Paths.vocalistBody: Guitar, bass, tabla, mixing — find the person and send a request. Your vocal sample goes along as the reference.
Paths.instrumentBody: Build a profile with samples and video. Your city, starting price, and turnaround stay up front.

Roles.title: Any musician
Roles.sub: Guitar is one example. Voice, tabla, dotara, production, lyrics — same door.

items.title: Vocalist
items.body: Sing, then find the player the song is missing.

items.title: Guitarist
items.body: Rhythm, solo, acoustic — strings around someone else's voice.

items.title: Other instrumentalist
items.body: Violin, flute, keys, tabla, dhol, dotara.

items.title: Producer / engineer
items.body: Beats, recording, mix — get the song standing.

items.title: Lyricist / composer
items.body: Words, melody, and the shape of the song.

Close.title: One song, two people.
Close.sub: Like a late-night studio — low light, clear work.

Footer.blurb: A place for musicians in Bangladesh to work together.

NotFound.title: This page isn't here

Find.title: Find a musician
Find.intro: Write what you need in one sentence. City, instrument, genre, budget, and time are enough.
Find.disclaimer: This reads the sample profiles on this site. It is not a live model, and it does not invent people.

Editor.title: Multitrack Studio
Editor.sub: Line up takes on one shared timeline, trim, split and fade clips, balance the mix, record over it, then export a WAV or send it to a musician.
Editor.rights: Upload only audio you have the right to use.
Editor.loaded: The take from the previous page is loaded on a track.
Editor.decodeError: That file could not be read. Try WAV or MP3.
Editor.needFile: Add at least one audio file.
Editor.micDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in your browser to record.
Editor.recordingHint: Recording… the other tracks play so you can overdub in sync. Press Space or the mic button to stop.
Editor.noShowcaseAudio: No audio showcases in the community yet.
Editor.emptyLane: Empty track — drop a file here or use +
Editor.dropHint: Drop audio files anywhere on this page, or use Import audio. WAV, MP3, M4A, OGG.
Editor.noSelection: Select a clip to edit its exact position, trim, gain and fades.
Editor.shortcuts: Space play/pause · S split at playhead · Delete remove clip · Ctrl+D duplicate · Ctrl+Z undo · Ctrl+Shift+Z redo · L loop · Home start. Drag a clip to move it (also to another track), drag its edges to trim, drag the small top corners to fade. Drag on the ruler to set a loop. Double-click a slider to reset it.

Editor.sendHint: The mix is rendered to WAV, uploaded, and sent as a link in your chat with that musician.
